name: Phases commute through CNOT
summary: A Z-rotation on the control of a CNOT commutes with the CNOT.
description:
A Z-phase gate on the control qubit commutes with a CNOT gate. In the ZX-calculus this is just [spider fusion](../spider-fusion/): both the phase and the control are Z-spiders, so they fuse and unfuse on the other side. With the colours swapped (also shown on this page), an X-phase gate on the target commutes with the CNOT in the same way.

This is the simplest example of how ZX-diagrams make commutation relations in circuits visible: gates commute when the spiders they meet are of the same colour.
